Another nearby read was "a one-clue surface theme". Early clues often tempt you to overfit the board around one obvious surface similarity. The final answer works because it keeps every clue at the same level of specificity, not because one clue happens to fit first.

The answer was "Words that come before “drop”". The turn came when I let "Drag-and-" lead the solve. After that, Eaves and Rain became the real confirmation check, because they had to fit the same idea without changing the rule or stretching the answer.

For the final pass, I checked Back, Eye, Eaves, Rain, Drag-and- one by one. The answer worked only if the whole list could stay inside one tight reading, not because one early clue happened to match a broad topic.
The answer was "Words that come before “drop”".
